title: Target Client creation Supabase and PowerSync provider slice

surfaces.currentBehavior: Locks the isolated Swift target to reviewed PowerSync 1.16.1, PowerSync SQLite core 0.5.3 and encrypted CSQLite 3.51.2 dependency revisions.
surfaces.notes: Target-only dependency lock; it does not alter the Firebase application package graph.

securityRequirements: Provider versions are exact and CSQLite encryption support is enabled
syncRequirements: Any dependency change reruns offline durability, upload and both staging-build gates

migration.rule: Use only in the isolated target package until explicit target release authorization.
reconciliation: Package resolution matches the exact reviewed direct versions

acceptance: The provider target resolves reproducibly and both target destinations compile

surfaces.currentBehavior: Defines edition-3 target Sync Streams for the authenticated Principal, active memberships and Accounts, Account-scoped Clients, and immutable operation results.
surfaces.notes: Locally reviewed stream contract only; no hosted PowerSync instance has been provisioned or activated.

securityRequirements: Every stream derives tenant scope from auth.user_id() through active membership
syncRequirements: Client identity and terminal operation evidence synchronize together without trusting client-authored scope

migration.rule: Deploy only to an isolated target environment after the vertical-spike gate authorizes it.
reconciliation: Cross-account fixtures yield no Client or operation-result rows

acceptance: A real Sync Stream upload/readback and cross-tenant denial pass before this surface advances

surfaces.currentBehavior: Creates the isolated spike Principal, Account, membership, Client and immutable operation-result schema; explicit grants/RLS; private membership helpers; and one idempotent trusted Client creation handler behind a public invoker RPC. Malformed or out-of-range envelope timestamps are durably rejected rather than escaping as cast failures.
surfaces.notes: All relations are spike_-prefixed and exist only in local isolated Supabase at this checkpoint.

securityRequirements: Direct writes are revoked; authenticated Principal and client-management membership are re-derived server-side; cross-account rows are hidden
syncRequirements: Handler returns one immutable applied or durable rejected result bound to the exact operation fingerprint

migration.rule: This spike schema is not final migration DDL and imports no Firebase data.
reconciliation: Exact replay creates one Client and one operation result; changed replay cannot rebind

acceptance: Local database and Data API tests prove authorization, isolation, immutability and replay

surfaces.currentBehavior: Configures one isolated local Supabase project identity for repeatable target schema and API testing.
surfaces.notes: Contains no hosted project reference or production credential.

securityRequirements: Local environment is distinct from every source and hosted target environment
syncRequirements: Local reset reproducibly applies the complete spike migration and seed

migration.rule: Use for local tests only; never link or deploy from this configuration implicitly.
reconciliation: Local reset starts from empty disposable state

acceptance: The isolated local database resets without contacting hosted resources

surfaces.currentBehavior: Runs 19 pgTAP assertions covering Client creation, exact replay, changed replay, same-name identities, durable validation rejection including timestamp overflow, direct-write denial, capability denial, timestamp binding and cross-account isolation.

securityRequirements: Tests execute as authenticated synthetic users and assert RLS/non-enumerating denial
syncRequirements: Replay and terminal-result behavior match the upload connector contract

migration.rule: Use no production-derived rows or credentials.
reconciliation: Every accepted operation has exactly one Client and immutable result

acceptance: All 18 pgTAP assertions pass from a clean reset

surfaces.currentBehavior: Seeds three synthetic auth users, Principals, two Accounts, and owner/restricted/other-account memberships for local authorization tests.

securityRequirements: Fixtures separate owner, restricted member and other-account access
syncRequirements: Stable fixture IDs support repeatable local API and RLS verification

migration.rule: Never deploy these synthetic identities or treat them as migration input.
reconciliation: Seed rows satisfy every explicit FK and membership precondition

acceptance: All positive and negative identities exercise the intended branch

surfaces.currentBehavior: Calls the local Supabase Data API with short-lived synthetic user JWTs and verifies apply, exact replay, scoped readback, cross-account hiding, capability denial and direct-write denial.
surfaces.notes: Reads local CLI status without printing local keys and contacts no hosted endpoint.

surfaces: Local Client creation Data API integration test
securityRequirements: Only local synthetic user tokens and the local publishable key are used; no service role is sent
syncRequirements: The REST representation matches the typed app/MCP server-result contract

migration.rule: Run only while the isolated local Supabase stack is active.
reconciliation: API readback observes exactly one Client after exact replay

acceptance: Local REST apply/replay/RLS/direct-write checks all pass

surfaces.currentBehavior: Defines the PowerSync local schema for Principal, Account, membership, Client, insert-only Client command, local-only operation evidence and immutable server results.

securityRequirements: Command payload is insert-only and local operation state is never synchronized as authority
syncRequirements: Local columns align with streamed server rows while pending_operation_id remains local optimism evidence

migration.rule: Schema evolution remains isolated until compatibility testing closes A-004.

acceptance: PowerSync schema validation succeeds and exact CRUD transaction shape is asserted

surfaces.currentBehavior: Implements Client core-details observation from local PowerSync rows with explicit waiting, partial, stale and ready truth; pending optimistic rows can never be labeled authoritative.
surfaces.notes: No direct network or backend SDK leaks through the core query port.

securityRequirements: Queries bind exact Account and Client identifiers
syncRequirements: Pending local operation evidence overrides earlier has-synced state and keeps the view partial

migration.rule: Use target local rows only; do not read Firebase cache through this adapter.
reconciliation: Server-synchronized rows clear local optimism and may become ready

acceptance: Optimistic rows render immediately but never as authoritative

surfaces.currentBehavior: Accepts one CreateClient command offline in one local transaction that persists operation evidence, an optimistic Client row and an insert-only upload command; exact replay returns the same receipt and changed replay is refused.
surfaces.notes: Physical encrypted local persistence is tested; server authority remains separate.

securityRequirements: Caller cannot omit Account, actor, contract or fingerprint binding from the typed command
syncRequirements: The Client projection and command enter one two-row PowerSync CRUD transaction

migration.rule: Create no Firebase write adapter and no dual-write path.
reconciliation: Restart restores exactly one Client and one operation for an accepted command

acceptance: Offline acceptance is atomic, durable and idempotent

surfaces.currentBehavior: Composes the encrypted per-Principal/Account local Client runtime and exposes create, watch, pending-upload count, cipher inspection and explicit close/delete behavior.
surfaces.notes: The local staging shell opens no hosted connection.

securityRequirements: Database path and Keychain service are namespaced by validated local environment, Principal and Account
syncRequirements: Runtime exposes pending queue evidence and explicit lifecycle boundaries

migration.rule: Never reuse the Firebase cache or production bundle namespace.
reconciliation: Close/reopen restores encrypted bytes for the same namespace

acceptance: Encrypted local runtime composes and survives process-style restart

surfaces.currentBehavior: Validates an absolute SQLite path and a 32-byte lowercase hexadecimal key before opening PowerSync with SQLCipher PRAGMA key configuration.
surfaces.notes: Encryption key bytes are never logged or stored in the database path.

securityRequirements: Relative/non-database paths and malformed key material fail before open
syncRequirements: Every local target database opens through the same encrypted factory

migration.rule: Do not point this factory at Firebase caches or source application data.
reconciliation: Raw database bytes do not contain the stored Client display name

acceptance: Invalid inputs fail and persisted content is encrypted

surfaces.currentBehavior: Validates the exact optimistic Client plus insert-only command transaction, calls the trusted Client handler, drains applied or durably rejected operations, and updates local-only terminal state.
surfaces.notes: Credentials and command applier are injected; no production endpoint is embedded.

securityRequirements: Unexpected row count/table/op/data or optimistic-command mismatch fails closed
syncRequirements: Queue completion occurs only after a matching terminal server result; permanent rejection cannot poison later uploads

migration.rule: Connect only inside an authorized isolated target environment.
reconciliation: One accepted local transaction produces one handler call and one terminal local operation state

acceptance: Applied and rejected terminal results drain once; malformed shape does not

surfaces.currentBehavior: Loads or creates a random 256-bit local database key in a this-device-only Keychain item scoped by service and Principal/Account namespace.
surfaces.notes: Logout disposition remains governed by the separate pending-work policy.

securityRequirements: Keys use secure randomness and WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly accessibility
syncRequirements: Stable namespace reuses the key; different Principal/Account namespaces cannot share it

migration.rule: Generate target keys locally; never import Firebase credentials or cache keys.
reconciliation: The key is valid 32-byte lowercase hex when supplied to the database factory

acceptance: Database encryption is active and restart uses the same scoped key

surfaces.currentBehavior: Posts the typed Client creation command to the Supabase RPC using a nonempty injected user access token and publishable key, preserves millisecond timestamps, decodes the terminal result and validates exact Operation, Account, fingerprint and Client identity.
surfaces.notes: No service-role or embedded hosted credential exists.

surfaces: Swift Supabase Client creation RPC adapter
securityRequirements: Only an injected scoped user token and public key are sent
syncRequirements: Response identity/fingerprint mismatch fails before PowerSync queue completion

migration.rule: Use only with a validated target environment and authenticated target session.
reconciliation: Swift and MCP call the same RPC argument/result contract

acceptance: HTTP request and typed response boundaries match the trusted local handler

surfaces.notes: Uses disposable encrypted local databases and fake HTTP/upload boundaries; no hosted provider access.
